# The Gilded Rat

The Gilded Rat is the busiest tavern in Port Verity, its common room thick with pipe
smoke and the smell of watered ale. Innkeeper Mirella Fenn has run the place for
eleven years and forgets nothing a paying customer says. Sailors trade rumours over
the bar while the Harbour Watch pretends not to listen.

Captain Aldric Voss holds court in the back room most evenings, weighing which
rumours are worth a coin and which are worth ignoring. He answers to nobody but the
harbourmaster, and even that arrangement is a formality he tolerates rather than
respects.
